text.tspan: Fertility rate vs. share living in extreme poverty 2024
The total fertility rate, in a given year. Extreme poverty is defined as living below the International Poverty Line

tspan.tspan: UN, World Population Prospects (2024); World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2026)
Poverty data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices to account for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.

text.tspan: Depending on the country and year, it relates to income (measured after taxes and benefits) or to consumption, per capita. Where data for
2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2019 and 2026 is shown instead.
